verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developers.kit.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as markdown, and doc pages are served as .md files. Kit also ships a Developer Docs MCP that gives coding agents live, queryable access to the full API reference instead of cached or hallucinated docs. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
